description: The Department of the Air Force Library Program has the following requirement: Overdrive offers downloadable e-books, e-audio books, and movies for checkout through their online system. These materials include current fiction, non-fiction, language learning materials, reference and recreation materials. Must provide a large and growing catalog of books and audio books in digital format to add to existing DAFL collection on the OverDrive platfrom. DAFL VCL wants to add content to the existing 5 million worth of content already on the platform we have a contract for with DoD Libraries.
